title: Star-Shaped Integral Cartan-Type Matrices and an Egyptian-Fraction Classification of Affine Weighted Trees
summary: We study a concrete family of symmetric integral $Z$-matrices attached to weighted star trees. The arms are ordinary type-$A$ chains and the central diagonal entry is an arbitrary positive integer $k$ rather than being fixed to the Cartan value $2$. This gives a matrix-theoretic and graph-theoretic version of the so called Berger construction: it extends the simply laced affine Dynkin stars while remaining accessible through elementary linear algebra.
